verses.text: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

xrefs.text: And David speaks likewise of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:
I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
Therefore let it be known to you, brothers, that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.

verses.text: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

xrefs.text: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.
And no lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.
that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them. And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.
Rid yourselves, therefore, of all malice, deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander.

instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD before His tabernacle— that man shall incur bloodguilt. He has shed blood and must be cut off from among his people.

verses.text: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.

xrefs.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.

verses.text: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah

xrefs.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

Then the Ekronites called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, “Send away the ark of the God of Israel. It must return to its place, so that it will not kill us and our people!” For a deadly confusion had pervaded the city; the hand of God was very heavy upon it.
Surely no fear of me should terrify you; nor will my hand be heavy upon you.
Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.

verses.text: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

xrefs.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
Then David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” “The LORD has taken away your sin,” Nathan replied. “You will not die.
For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.

verses.text: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.

xrefs.text: Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.

When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
For He says: “In the time of favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the time of favor; now is the day of salvation!
Then they will call on me, but I will not answer; they will earnestly seek me, but will not find me.
My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.

verses.text: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

xrefs.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.

verses.text: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.

xrefs.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding;
Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold.

verses.text: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.

xrefs.text: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!
“For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.”
who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air?’
Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.

verses.text: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.

xrefs.text: Whoever heeds instruction will find success, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
Disaster pursues sinners, but prosperity is the reward of the righteous.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow wickedness, there will be wrath and anger.

verses.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.

xrefs.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
